executive_summary: Maven build failed with 100 compilation errors across test classes. Root cause: DTO constructors changed from parameterized to no-arg constructors, service method signatures changed to require additional parameters (userId as String, taskId as UUID), and ErrorResponse missing getCode() method. All test classes need updates to use builder pattern or setters for DTOs and pass correct parameters to service methods.

errors.message: DTO constructors require no arguments but tests pass parameters (TaskCreateRequest, TaskResponse, TaskUpdateRequest, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse)
errors.root_cause: DTOs were refactored from parameterized constructors to no-argument constructors. Tests still use old constructor signatures with multiple parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all DTO instantiations in TaskControllerTest to use no-arg constructor followed by setter methods, or implement builder pattern. Example: new TaskCreateRequest().setTitle(...).setDescription(...) instead of new TaskCreateRequest(title, description, ...)

errors.message: Service method signatures changed: createTask, getUserTasks, getTaskById, updateTask, deleteTask, bulkCreateTasks now require userId parameter
errors.root_cause: TaskService interface methods were refactored to require userId (String) as first parameter for authorization. Tests call methods without this parameter.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add userId parameter to all TaskService method calls. Example: taskService.createTask(
, request) instead of taskService.createTask(request). Extract userId from test context or use mock user ID.

errors.message: Type mismatch: long cannot be converted to String for userId parameter
errors.root_cause: userId changed from long to String type in service method signatures. Tests still pass long values.
errors.fix_recommendation: Convert all userId references from long to String. Replace numeric IDs like 1L with String IDs like
or UUID strings throughout test class.

errors.message: Type mismatch: taskId changed from long to UUID in getTaskById, updateTask, deleteTask methods
errors.root_cause: Task ID type changed from long to UUID in service interface. Tests still use long primitive values.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all long taskId values with UUID. Use UUID.randomUUID() for test data or UUID.fromString() to convert string literals. Update mock responses to return UUID instead of long.

errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse DTO no longer has getCode() method. Tests attempt to verify error codes using this non-existent getter.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove all assertions calling response.getCode(). If error codes are still needed, check if ErrorResponse has alternative field like errorCode or status, or remove code verification from tests.

errors.message: Enum type mismatch: Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority; userId type mismatch (long vs String); taskId arithmetic operations invalid for UUID
errors.root_cause: Multiple type changes in data store: Priority enum renamed to TaskPriority, userId changed from long to String, taskId changed from long to UUID. Tests use old types.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update InMemoryTaskDataStoreTest: (1) Replace Priority enum with TaskPriority, (2) Change all userId from long to String type, (3) Replace taskId long with UUID and remove arithmetic operations like taskId+1, use UUID.randomUUID() instead.

summary: 6 grouped compilation error categories found affecting 100 individual error instances
